name: Colosseum-ktx2
summary: Colosseum-gltf with every texture as UASTC KTX2 (Zstandard, full mip chains) named by KHR_texture_basisu alone, no PNG or JPEG: a GPU samples them as BC7, ETC2 or ASTC blocks in a quarter of the memory RGBA8 needs.
origin: AssetANT release Colosseum-gltf-v1, its textures re-encoded as KTX2
notes: Release-only: converted from Colosseum-gltf-v1 (sha256 172fed54..., source.lock) by scripts/ktx2/gltf_to_ktx2.py with assets/Colosseum-ktx2/ktx2.json and KTX-Software 4.4.2's ktx create (encoder.lock): UASTC quality 2 without RDO, Zstandard level 18, box-filtered wrapping mip chains, sRGB for base colour and linear for normal and metallic-roughness maps; LICENSES/NOTICE.txt lists the changes, ktx2-report.json each texture's encoding.
